images.caption: Figure 1:Illustration of our geometric contraction and its effect on stream mixing.(a)Architecture of hyper-connections at layerll. Our method focuses on the hyper-connection module.(b)Two-dimensional projections of the Birkhoff polytope forn=3n\!=\!3, along with the sampled trajectories of layer-averaged residual matrices during training, ended at the star. Traditional methods likemHC-litedo not encourage an interior exploration of the polytope, so the residual matrices remain close to a permutation vertex; our moderate contraction encourages interior exploration, while a strong contraction may drive the residual matrices toward the uniform barycenter.(c)Layer-averaged residual matrices and cosine similarity distributions between streams forn=4n\!=\!4.
